observation: Fresh main now constrains run-ledger changeset references to the existing ChangesetStore identity syntax, but ChangesetStore itself still accepts arbitrary string runId values at stage/read boundaries even though canonical RunStore identities are restricted to run-<letters/digits/hyphens>. A durable changeset can therefore claim a run identity that RunStore would deterministically reject.
changes: Reuse the existing RunStore identity syntax at ChangesetStore stage and durable read boundaries.
Publish the same runId pattern in the existing changeset v0.3 contract.
Do not add cross-store existence checks, lifecycle coupling or a new run identity format.
